description: Boot-smoke milestone baselines. The 2026-09-20 re-basing applies the same shape to the `loader` milestone, which until then was gated only by accident through a hard-coded frame-300 observation point in the boot smoke. Re-record `baseline` deliberately, in the same commit as the change that grows the transport on purpose, and state the reason in the commit message.
